items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I noticed the boss would come, Mr. Corrigan was his name.

ctx.x: Cocktails, so I went in and I played it, and I noticed the boss would come, Mr. Corrigan was his name. I'll never forget him. And after I played that for a while they seemed to like my playing, and let's see, they had Jack Butter Buckley playing trumpet. They had -- what's his name, he used to play with Fletcher -- who used to, Garvin Bushell on sax. Let's see. Emmett Matthews on tenor sax. I should be able to (Unintelligible) name the whole band, because I worked with them for quite a while.
